The '''Tennuutta sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Casfield 6]], [[Gestron]], [[Kem Stor Ai]], [[Nath Goordi]], and [[Ord Tiddell/Legends|Ord Tiddell]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref>[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']] and ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' both state that the [[Battle of Salvara]] took place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].</ref> the Tennuutta sector was the site of the [[Tenuutta Skirmishes]].<ref name="GM Screen" />
